lines.say: Part six: Sickle cell disease.
Pichhla part ek line mein: hereditary hemochromatosis mein phlebotomy, thalassemia major mein chelation. Theek hai?
Ab ek aur hereditary hemoglobin bimari, jo Saudi Arabia ke exams mein bahut aati hai.
Topic eighteen: sickle cell disease kya hai.
Sickle cell disease ek autosomal recessive bimari hai.
Isme beta-globin chain ki position 6 par ek point mutation hoti hai: glutamic acid ki jagah valine aa jaata hai. Ek baar aur: position 6, glutamic acid se valine.
Is badle hue hemoglobin ko HbS kehte hain. HbS, HbS.
Jab oxygen kam hota hai, HbS jam kar lambi rods banata hai, aur red cell ko hansiye, yaani sickle, jaisa tedha kar deta hai.
Ab do cheezein hoti hain, aur yahi sickle cell ki do pehchaan hain. Pehli, tedhe cells chhoti vessels mein atak jaate hain aur blood flow rok dete hain: vaso-occlusion.
Doosri, tedhe cells jaldi toot jaate hain: hemolytic anemia. Vaso-occlusion aur hemolysis. Ek baar aur: vaso-occlusion aur hemolysis.
Kin logon mein zyada? African aur East Mediterranean descent mein.
Yaad rakhna hai: beta-globin position 6 point mutation, HbS. Do hallmarks: vaso-occlusion aur hemolytic anemia.
Topic nineteen: diagnosis.
CBC mein anemia. Hemolysis ke markers, jaise high reticulocytes, high LDH, aur indirect bilirubin.
Blood film par sickle cells, target cells, aur Howell-Jolly bodies.

Howell-Jolly bodies kyun? Yeh chhote nuclear tukde hain, jinhe normally spleen saaf karta hai; sickle cell mein spleen kaam nahi karta, isliye dikhte hain. Ek baar aur: Howell-Jolly bodies matlab spleen kaam nahi kar raha.
Confirm kaise? Hemoglobin electrophoresis, jo HbS dikhata hai. Hemoglobin electrophoresis. Theek hai?
Yaad rakhna hai: smear par sickle cells aur Howell-Jolly bodies. Confirm hemoglobin electrophoresis.
Topic twenty: acute complications.
Acute complications ko teen dibbon mein socho.
Pehla, infections: spleen nahi, toh sepsis, pneumonia aur meningitis ka bada khatra.

Doosra, severe anemia: splenic sequestration, jismein khoon achanak spleen mein bhar jaata hai; aplastic crisis, jismein marrow kuch din ruk jaata hai, aksar parvovirus B19 se; aur hyperhemolysis. Ek baar aur: aplastic crisis, parvovirus B19.

Teesra, vaso-occlusive phenomena, yaani jahan blood flow ruka, wahan damage: acute painful episodes; stroke; acute chest syndrome, jismein bukhar, chest pain aur naya lung infiltrate; priapism; aur venous thromboembolism.
Bachchon mein haath-pair ki ungliyon ki sujan, dactylitis, aksar pehla sign hota hai. Dactylitis, pehla sign.
Yaad rakhna hai: acute: infections, severe anemia, yaani sequestration aur aplastic crisis, aur vaso-occlusion, yaani pain, stroke, acute chest syndrome, priapism.
Topic twenty-one: chronic complications.
Lambe samay mein har organ par asar padta hai.
Spleen: zyada-tar patients ka spleen 2 se 4 saal ki umar tak kaam karna band kar deta hai, functional asplenia. Ek baar aur: 2 se 4 saal, functional asplenia.
Brain: lagbhag 25 percent patients ko 45 saal tak kam se kam ek stroke.
Haddiyan: avascular necrosis, khaaskar femoral head, aur osteoporosis. Avascular necrosis, femoral head.
Lungs: pulmonary hypertension. Kidney: renal impairment aur hypertension.
Liver: transfusion se iron overload, ya dawaon se damage. Gallbladder: pigment gallstones, kyunki chronic hemolysis se bilirubin zyada. Pigment gallstones.
Growth: puberty late aur height kam. Skin: chronic leg ulcers. Heart: diastolic dysfunction wali cardiomyopathy. Aankh: proliferative retinopathy.
Clinical hook: asplenia ki wajah se in patients ko pneumococcal aur dusre vaccines zaroor dene chahiye.
Yaad rakhna hai: spleen 2 se 4 saal tak khatam. Avascular necrosis femoral head. Pigment gallstones. Pulmonary hypertension aur stroke.
Topic twenty-two: painful crisis.
Painful crisis kya trigger karta hai? Infection, dehydration, thand, aur oonchi jagah jaana, kyunki wahan oxygen kam.
Patient pairon, haathon aur peeth mein dard ke saath aata hai.
Management do steps mein: pehla rehydration, doosra pain management. Rehydration aur pain, rehydration aur pain.
Exam ka ek trap: agar scenario mein bukhar bhi hai, toh sahi answer antibiotics, kyunki spleen nahi hai, aur infection jaan le sakta hai. Ek baar aur: bukhar ho, toh antibiotics. Theek hai?
Yaad rakhna hai: painful crisis mein rehydration aur pain control. Bukhar ho toh antibiotics.
Ek baar dobara dekhte hain: sickle cell autosomal recessive, beta-globin position 6, HbS; hallmarks vaso-occlusion aur hemolysis.
Smear par sickle cells aur Howell-Jolly bodies, confirm electrophoresis.
Acute: infections, sequestration aur aplastic crisis, pain, stroke, acute chest syndrome, priapism.
Chronic: spleen 2 se 4 saal tak khatam, avascular necrosis, pigment gallstones, pulmonary hypertension.
Painful crisis mein rehydration aur pain control, bukhar ho toh antibiotics.
Ab poori file ek saath. Anemia matlab hemoglobin kam: male mein 13.5 se kam, female mein 12 se kam.
MCV se type: 80 se kam microcytic, jismein iron deficiency, chronic disease, sideroblastic aur thalassemia; 80 se 95 normocytic; 95 se upar macrocytic.
Har anemia mein fatigue, saans phoolna, pallor, tachycardia aur systolic murmur; iron deficiency mein khaas pica, koilonychia aur restless legs; IDA plus dysphagia, Plummer-Vinson.
IDA ke chaar raaste: blood loss, demand, absorption aur nutrition. Lab mein low ferritin, high TIBC, high RDW, pencil cells, aur Mentzer 13 se zyada.
Elderly mein IDA, colonoscopy. Pehle oral iron, CKD aur intolerance mein IV, severe symptoms mein transfusion, oral iron fail toh celiac.
Anemia of chronic disease mein iron hepcidin se band; ferritin normal ya high aur TIBC normal ya low; treatment underlying disease.
Beta thalassemia mein bahut kam MCV, normal iron panel, target cells, Mentzer 13 se kam, aur confirm electrophoresis; major mein transfusion se iron overload, toh deferoxamine.
Hereditary hemochromatosis mein HFE gene, cardiomyopathy, diabetes aur liver disease, aur treatment phlebotomy.
Sickle cell mein HbS, vaso-occlusion aur hemolysis; painful crisis mein rehydration aur pain control, bukhar ho toh antibiotics.
Rapid recall, khud se poochho. Sawal suno, ruko, khud jawab bolo, phir answer suno.
MCV 75, kaun sa dibba?
Microcytic. Microcytic.
IDA ka sabse important test?
Ferritin. Ferritin.
IDA mein TIBC?
High. High.
Mentzer index 15?
Iron deficiency. Iron deficiency.
IDA plus dysphagia?
Plummer-Vinson. Plummer-Vinson.
65 saal ke aadmi mein IDA, next step?
Colonoscopy. Colonoscopy.
Dialysis patient mein iron kaise?
IV iron. IV.
Severe anemia ke saath heart failure?
Blood transfusion. Transfusion.
Oral iron se fayda nahi?
Celiac test. Celiac.
Ferritin high aur Hb low, rheumatoid arthritis ka patient?
Anemia of chronic disease. ACD.
Microcytic anemia, iron panel normal, Mentzer 11?
Beta thalassemia trait. Thalassemia trait.
Thalassemia major, transfusion par, ferritin high?
Deferoxamine. Deferoxamine.
Hemochromatosis ka treatment?
Phlebotomy. Phlebotomy.
Sickle cell smear par spleen na hone ka sign?
Howell-Jolly bodies. Howell-Jolly bodies.
Sickle crisis plus bukhar?
Antibiotics. Antibiotics.
Ab file ke points, jin par dhyan dena hai.
File mein anemia ka cutoff male mein 13.5 gram per dL likha hai. WHO ka common cutoff male mein 13, aur non-pregnant female mein 12 hai; apne exam ke reference wala number yaad rakhna.

File kehti hai ki elderly IDA mein colonoscopy next step hai. Standard practice mein adult men aur postmenopausal women mein bidirectional endoscopy, yaani upper GI endoscopy aur colonoscopy dono, ki jaati hai.
Ibuprofen wale MCQ mein paracetamol sahi jawab hai. Agar options mein proton pump inhibitor ke saath NSAID ho, toh woh bhi practice mein ek raasta hai; par simple switch ke liye paracetamol.

Hemochromatosis ke confirmation ke liye file liver biopsy aur HFE gene test likhti hai. Aaj ki practice mein pehle ferritin aur transferrin saturation, phir HFE gene test; liver biopsy ab sirf tab, jab liver damage ki severity jaanni ho, ya diagnosis pakka na ho.
